Our Services

From your big bridal day to everyday glow — every service is priced on call, so you always confirm the exact price at the salon before you book.

Bridal Makeup

A complete bridal look for your special day — flawless base, elegant eye makeup and a finish that lasts from baraat to walima, styled to match your dress and jewellery.

Party Makeup

📲 Book on WhatsApp & How to Pay

Make your own booking right here on this website — pick your service, date and time, then send the booking straight to the salon.

  1. Choose your service, date and time in the booking form above and tap “Prepare My Booking Request” — your booking request appears on this page.
  2. Visit the salon with your booking request (show this screen, or the copied details) to confirm your appointment slot and price.
  3. Pay at the salon as the salon confirms on your visit. Only pay the salon itself — never pay anyone else for this booking.
  4. Keep your booking details saved until your appointment is done.

This salon has no phone number published yet — please visit the salon to confirm your booking. Ask the salon to share its number so bookings can be confirmed by phone next time.
